inputs.resolution: 0.5 x 0.625 deg cell (Horn slope at ~926 m, averaged)

modules.limits: Cell-scale statistics: individual craters, scarps, dunes and channels are not resolved. Landform class is a relief class, not a mapped landform.
modules.question: How does the ground's height, steepness and relief at this place compare with the target?
target: slope distribution (MOLA 463 m / LOLA 118 m windows)

validation.method: Unit and range checks; landform thresholds reproduced from stored inputs; slope distribution equals the Phase III sub-cell product.
tests: landform classes cover every valid cell with finite relief
class boundaries at 50/200 m relief and 500/2500 m elevation

modules.limits: No geological map or volcano catalogue could be acquired. ASTERRO does not infer rock type from climate or terrain.
modules.question: Which rock units and geological settings are present?
target: IAU feature type of catalogued targets (crater, mons, vallis ...)

validation.method: Not applicable until data are acquired.

modules.limits: No spectral or mineral-occurrence data could be acquired. A spectral index would in any case indicate a possible mineral group, not identify a mineral.
modules.question: Are there spectral signs of mineral groups (iron oxides, clays, carbonates, evaporites)?

validation.method: Not applicable until data are acquired.

inputs.note: decoded from GIBS rendering, 0.6 K steps

modules.limits: Aqua overpass times (about 13:30 and 01:30) are not the daily maximum and minimum. Thermal inertia is not estimated: it needs a physical model and albedo, which ASTERRO does not hold.
modules.question: How strongly does the surface heat and cool, and how stable is that from year to year?
target: MEDA / REMS ground temperature (Mars rover sites)

validation.method: Interannual SD recomputed from the yearly ranges; cells with fewer than 5 years left missing.
tests: iav missing where fewer than 5 valid years

modules.limits: No terrain shadowing, clouds or measured ground irradiance. Lunar permanently shadowed regions are not represented: no illumination product could be acquired.
modules.question: How much sunlight reaches the top of the atmosphere here, and are there months of polar night?

validation.method: Polar-night months must occur only within about 1.5 deg of the polar circles or poleward; TOA must decrease toward the poles in the annual mean.
tests: no polar night equatorward of 65 deg (polar circles 66.56 deg)
annual TOA maximum in the tropics

modules.limits: No observed surface-water history, snow cover, glacier or permafrost map could be acquired. Former lakes cannot be detected. Air temperature is not ground temperature.
modules.question: How dry is the place, how seasonal is its water, and how often does it freeze?

validation.method: Indicators recomputed from the monthly climatology; UNEP thresholds applied to P/PET; missing P/PET stays missing.
tests: aridity class missing exactly where P/PET is missing
freeze months 12 implies MAAT below zero

modules.limits: No aerosol or wind product could be acquired. Aerosol optical depth would describe the air column, not dust settling on the ground.
modules.question: How dusty and windy is the place?
target: Mars surface pressure (MEDA, measured at Jezero)

validation.method: Not applicable until data are acquired.

modules.limits: No vegetation or occurrence data could be acquired. ASTERRO never infers extremophiles or biosignatures from environmental similarity.
modules.question: What is known about life and vegetation here?

validation.method: Not applicable until data are acquired.

modules.limits: No Earth cave inventory was acquired, so Earth cells carry no subsurface information. Cave geometry is never estimated.
modules.question: Are caves, lava tubes or pits known here?
target: catalogued lunar pit: Marius Hills Pit (LROC Pits Atlas)

validation.method: Planetary entries come from the existing registry only.
tests: no Earth cell has a subsurface value

modules.limits: Operational relevance ranks environments for rehearsal. It does not judge safety, access, permits or mission readiness.
modules.question: Which exploration activities could this place help rehearse, and what would not transfer?

validation.method: Uses the existing operation rules unchanged.
